{{alias}}( order, uplo, NCOLS, A, LDA, AF, LDAF, WORK )
    Computes reciprocal Cholesky pivot growth using a supplied factor.

    Parameters
    ----------
    order: string
        Storage layout: 'row-major' or 'column-major'.
    uplo: string
        Stored triangle: 'upper' or 'lower'.
    NCOLS: integer
        Nonnegative leading square prefix order.
    A: Float64Array
        Read-only original matrix.
    LDA: integer
        Leading dimension of A.
    AF: Float64Array
        Read-only supplied Cholesky factor.
    LDAF: integer
        Leading dimension of AF.
    WORK: Float64Array
        Scratch storage for 2*NCOLS maxima, disjoint from both inputs.

    Returns
    -------
    v: number
        Reciprocal pivot growth, capped at 1.

    Examples
    --------
    > var A = new Float64Array( [ 0.25, 0.0, 0.0, 4.0 ] );
    > var AF = new Float64Array( [ 0.5, 0.0, 0.0, 2.0 ] );
    > var WORK = new Float64Array( 4 );
    > {{alias}}( 'row-major', 'upper', 2, A, 2, AF, 2, WORK )
    0.5


{{alias}}.ndarray( uplo, NCOLS, A, a1, a2, oa, AF, f1, f2, of, W, sw, ow )
    Uses independent matrix and scratch strides and offsets.

    Parameters
    ----------
    uplo: string
        Stored triangle: 'upper' or 'lower'.
    NCOLS: integer
        Nonnegative leading square prefix order.
    A: Float64Array
        Original matrix.
    a1: integer
        Row stride of A.
    a2: integer
        Column stride of A.
    oa: integer
        Starting index of A.
    AF: Float64Array
        Supplied factor.
    f1: integer
        Row stride of AF.
    f2: integer
        Column stride of AF.
    oaF: integer
        Starting index of AF.
    W: Float64Array
        Scratch storage, disjoint from both inputs.
    sw: integer
        Nonzero workspace stride.
    ow: integer
        Workspace starting index.

    Returns
    -------
    v: number
        Reciprocal pivot growth.

    See Also
    --------
